# pve_ceph_init (Action)

Create the initial Ceph default configuration on a node (idempotent). Ceph must already be installed on the node — run the `pve_ceph_install` action first (it needs the provider's `ssh` block).

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "pve_ceph_init" "example" {
  config {
    node = "pve1"
  }
}

# terraform_data is a no-op stand-in; wire action.pve actions to the
# lifecycle events of any managed resource.
resource "terraform_data" "trigger" {
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.pve_ceph_init.example]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Optional

- `cluster_network` (String) Declare a separate cluster network, OSDs will route heartbeat, object replication and recovery traffic over it
- `disable_cephx` (Boolean) Disable cephx authentication.

WARNING: cephx is a security feature protecting against man-in-the-middle attacks. Only consider disabling cephx if your network is private! (default: 0)
- `min_size` (Number) Minimum number of available replicas per object to allow I/O (default: 2)
- `network` (String) Use specific network for all ceph related traffic
- `pg_bits` (Number) Placement group bits, used to specify the default number of placement groups.

Depreacted. This setting was deprecated in recent Ceph versions. (default: 6)
- `size` (Number) Targeted number of replicas per object (default: 3)
